/**\n
 * Creates a new Post entity.\n
 *\n
 * NOTE: the Method annotation is optional, but it's a recommended practice\n
 * to constraint the HTTP methods each controller responds to (by default\n
 * it responds to all methods).\n
 */\n
public function new(Request $request, EntityManagerInterface $entityManager): Response\n
{\n
    $post = new Post();\n
    $post->setAuthor($this->getUser());\n
\n
    // See https://symfony.com/doc/current/form/multiple_buttons.html\n
    $form = $this->createForm(PostType::class, $post)\n
        ->add('saveAndCreateNew', SubmitType::class);\n
\n
    $form->handleRequest($request);\n
\n
    // the isSubmitted() method is completely optional because the other\n
    // isValid() method already checks whether the form is submitted.\n
    // However, we explicitly add it to improve code readability.\n
    // See https://symfony.com/doc/current/forms.html#processing-forms\n
    if ($form->isSubmitted() && $form->isValid()) {\n
        $entityManager->persist($post);\n
        $entityManager->flush();\n
\n
        // Flash messages are used to notify the user about the result of the\n
        // actions. They are deleted automatically from the session as soon\n
        // as they are accessed.\n
        // See https://symfony.com/doc/current/controller.html#flash-messages\n
        $this->addFlash('success', 'post.created_successfully');\n
\n
        if ($form->get('saveAndCreateNew')->isClicked()) {\n
            return $this->redirectToRoute('admin_post_new');\n
        }\n
\n
        return $this->redirectToRoute('admin_post_index');\n
    }\n
\n
    return $this->render('admin/blog/new.html.twig', [\n
        'post' => $post,\n
        'form' => $form->createView(),\n
    ]);\n
}\n
\n \n

/**\n
 * Displays a form to edit an existing Post entity.\n
 */\n
public function edit(Request $request, Post $post, EntityManagerInterface $entityManager): Response\n
{\n
    $form = $this->createForm(PostType::class, $post);\n
    $form->handleRequest($request);\n
\n
    if ($form->isSubmitted() && $form->isValid()) {\n
        $entityManager->flush();\n
        $this->addFlash('success', 'post.updated_successfully');\n
\n
        return $this->redirectToRoute('admin_post_edit', ['id' => $post->getId()]);\n
    }\n
\n
    return $this->render('admin/blog/edit.html.twig', [\n
        'post' => $post,\n
        'form' => $form->createView(),\n
    ]);\n
}\n

public function edit(Request $request, EntityManagerInterface $entityManager): Response\n
{\n
    $user = $this->getUser();\n
\n
    $form = $this->createForm(UserType::class, $user);\n
    $form->handleRequest($request);\n
\n
    if ($form->isSubmitted() && $form->isValid()) {\n
        $entityManager->flush();\n
\n
        $this->addFlash('success', 'user.updated_successfully');\n
\n
        return $this->redirectToRoute('user_edit');\n
    }\n
\n
    return $this->render('user/edit.html.twig', [\n
        'user' => $user,\n
        'form' => $form->createView(),\n
    ]);\n
}\n

public function changePassword(Request $request, UserPasswordHasherInterface $passwordHasher, EntityManagerInterface $entityManager): Response\n
{\n
    $user = $this->getUser();\n
\n
    $form = $this->createForm(ChangePasswordType::class);\n
    $form->handleRequest($request);\n
\n
    if ($form->isSubmitted() && $form->isValid()) {\n
        $user->setPassword($passwordHasher->hashPassword($user, $form->get('newPassword')->getData()));\n
        $entityManager->flush();\n
\n
        return $this->redirectToRoute('security_logout');\n
    }\n
\n
    return $this->render('user/change_password.html.twig', [\n
        'form' => $form->createView(),\n
    ]);\n
}\n
